Docket 1.1.2: The query engine's item-path semantics now match the spec's own pinned reading, three defects deep in the evaluator: step slices bind per context node, so `project/task[0]` yields each project's first task instead of one task overall (the spec's own example, `project *//not @done[0]`, behaves as written); an over-indented line is a child of its nearest shallower item on both the parent and child axes, which previously disagreed; and top-level items are siblings under the document root, so `following-sibling` and `preceding-sibling` stop coming up empty at the outline's top.

Docket 1.1.1: The issue-triage repair pass: seven traced defects; the four engine-level ones are pinned by new tests, and the editor's three were fixed at the exact lines the traces named (the app crate carries smoke tests only).
Quire 1.5.6: Fixed: a `total` that overflows (`9..9` at 308 digits, twice) no longer crashes the whole app.
Quire 1.5.5: Fixed: the conversion arrow `->` no longer corrupts the tokenizer.
Quire 1.5.4: Fixed: three bugs in the line-reference re-pass machinery, found by a deep engine audit.
